propositions: Three token-identical _shadow helpers exist across _mcp_llm.py, _mcp_reads.py, and _mcp_writes.py, plus a fourth variant in _lib_ops.py with an explicit repo_root parameter that can be unified via a single definition with default repo_root=None.
Two token-identical _ticket_id helpers exist in llm/workflow/steps.py and llm/plan_review/decide_ops.py and must be consolidated into one definition.

Three token-identical _positive_int argparse converters exist in request.py, bridge.py, and reconcile.py (not counting the out-of-scope namesake in _config_resolvers.py which returns a default instead of raising) and must be unified into one definition.
Guard test must verify exactly one definition of each helper exists under src/rebar (outside owner modules) to prevent re-introduction of duplicates.
All ten call sites in _lib_ops must forward their repo_root argument to the consolidated _shadow helper to maintain correct repository context in shadow snapshots.
